entities.name: Undead
entities.description: A general classification for beings created or reanimated from the mortal remains of the living, mainly using black mana.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Described as probably the most unique undead: biomechanical, soulless entities of rotting tissue and metal infected through the Glistening oil.

entities.name: Glistening oil
entities.description: The substance through which Phyrexians are curated and infected.

relations.note: Described as probably the most unique type of undead beings
relations.quote: Phyrexians are probably the most unique type of undead beings
